allocationBoundary.removedSourceTupleLifetime: Produced by stellarDirectionAt, consumed immediately by rotateStellarDirection destructuring, no caller reference escapes
allocationBoundary.unchanged: Caller motionAt six-number tuple, lazy exact-frame caches, freeze of final ENU array, all other transforms/positions/subscribers
allocationBoundary.caveat: Source-level array expression count is not physical allocation or retention: host/target engines may scalar-replace or optimize it. Inlining also changes the helper-call shape; no second variant isolates call overhead.

benchmark.clock: process.hrtime.bigint monotonic host elapsed; nsPerCall is elapsed/calls, not target/thread CPU
benchmark.workload: All 8404 BSC rows plus actual selected SAO rows per 100 exact-time jobs, starting 1000ms after existing 2026 fixture and advancing 17000ms; input preparation/selection/I/O outside timing
benchmark.harness: Three sequential fresh Node processes, both orders after 10 alternating warm pairs, 24 timed comparison pairs and 12 interspersed baseline/self pairs per view. Every output consumed into matching finite checksums; no forced GC, heap snapshots, device, service or network.
benchmark.decisionRule: Only a host signal if every process paired 95% median interval is positive, pooled interval is positive, and pooled median exceeds observed baseline/self absolute p95. This is noise screening, not a product performance budget.
